description: Repairs an old or damaged photo of the user's (a photographed print, most often one from list_photos with uploads), paid from their credits: repair fixes scratches, tears and stains, faces enhances them, colourise adds colour to a black and white one. size 1K is Standard, 2K High quality, 4K Print quality; the price is by size. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.
name: restore
title: Restore an old photo
